Name: Defense: Treatment Bay at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: I'm mid-operation at the <Alias=TargetLocation>, and people outside want the painkillers in my cabinet. Keep them out until my patient is stable.

LogEntries.Entry: A medic at the <Alias=TargetLocation> is mid-operation in a field treatment bay, and someone outside wants the painkillers in her cabinet.
Someone is coming for the medic's painkillers at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. I need to hold the treatment bay until her patient is stable.
I held the medic's treatment bay at the <Alias=TargetLocation> until her patient was stable.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the medic at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Hold the treatment bay until the patient is stable (<Global=duo_MB84a_qst_count2>/3)

Lines.ResponseText: Then listen. I've got a patient open on the table and people outside who want what's in my cabinet. Keep them out of this bay until I'm done.
Every minute you give me is one he keeps.
I can assist if you need another pair of hands.
I need you on the door more. But come back after, and I'll show you what I did.
What do they want with your cabinet?
Painkillers. They'll sell them on. I'd rather they were in my patient.
Not now. Unless you're the help. Are you the help?
The treatment bay's in the middle of the site. Come straight in, and don't stop to talk to anyone outside.
He's stable. You can stop shooting now. Please.
